source: Picked from Visit Waco (Destination Waco) listings and official venue pages (Nov 2026); refreshed with the weekly update

spots.name: Magnolia Market at the Silos
spots.blurb: Shops, bakery, food trucks and lawn at the silos; closed Sundays.
spots.blurbEs: Tiendas, panadería, food trucks y jardín en los silos; cerrado los domingos.

spots.name: Waco Suspension Bridge & Riverwalk
spots.blurb: The 1870 pedestrian bridge over the Brazos, with the Cattle Drive sculptures and riverwalk.
spots.blurbEs: El puente peatonal de 1870 sobre el Brazos, con las esculturas Cattle Drive y el paseo ribereño.

spots.name: Cameron Park Zoo
spots.blurb: Walkable zoo with giraffes, orangutans and Komodo dragons; kids 2 and under free.
spots.blurbEs: Zoológico fácil de recorrer con jirafas, orangutanes y dragones de Komodo; menores de 2 años gratis.

spots.name: Dr Pepper Museum
spots.blurb: Two buildings of exhibits in the soft drink's original historic bottling plant.
spots.blurbEs: Dos edificios de exhibiciones en la planta embotelladora original del refresco.

spots.name: Waco Mammoth National Monument
spots.blurb: Guided tours of a dig shelter with a nursery herd of Pleistocene mammoths.
spots.blurbEs: Recorridos guiados por un refugio de excavación con una manada de mamuts del Pleistoceno.
